outcome: Give development director / property operations head a governed method to improve unplanned capital replacement spend using asset age, failures, replacement costs and warranty, with final decisions…
overview: Facilities Asset Lifecycle Capital Planning addresses resource allocation is planned in silos, producing avoidable delays and occasionally infeasible instructions in construction and real estate operations. The first proof of value uses asset age, failures, replacement costs and warranty. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is unplanned capital replacement spend, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: asset age, failures, replacement costs and warranty; define unplanned capital replacement spend and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Development Director / Property Operations Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including replay disruption and edge cases with hard constraints enforced.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for unplanned capital replacement spend
